---
title: "2025 KIVI Hoogendoorn Fluid Mechanics Award"
date: 2026-05-20
lang: en
---

I’m happy to share that my PhD thesis, *Burner Development Strategies in the Context of Thermoacoustic Instability*, received the 2025 KIVI Hoogendoorn Fluid Mechanics Award for the best PhD thesis defended in the 2024–2025 academic year. I’m grateful to everyone who supported me throughout my research.

Read the [TU/e ME post](https://lnkd.in/p/e5aN39X5) or LinkedIn post of [ORkli](https://lnkd.in/p/eVryPwNQ) and see the [official award announcement](https://www.tudelft.nl/2026/jm-burgerscentrum/kivi-hoogendoorn-fluid-mechanics-award-2025).
